name: DockRoute
description: External-DNS for plain Docker hosts: DockRoute watches your running containers, reads dockroute.* labels and reconciles the matching DNS records - and Cloudflare Tunnel routes - in a pluggable provider. Your Docker labels are the source of truth; DockRoute makes the provider match them, and never alters records it cannot prove it manages (ExternalDNS-style TXT ownership). Opt a container in with labels: dockroute.enabled=true and dockroute.hostname=app.example.com. Start with the default 'log' provider for a zero-credential dry run, then switch to 'cloudflare'. Docs: https://www.dockroute.dev

paths.name: Docker socket
paths.description: Docker Engine socket (read-only). DockRoute only listens to events and lists containers.

variables.name: Provider
variables.description: DNS provider: 'log' (dry run, prints desired state, no credentials needed) or 'cloudflare'.

variables.name: Owner ID
variables.description: Ownership id written to companion TXT records; lets several DockRoute instances share a zone safely.

variables.name: Sync policy
variables.description: sync = create/update/delete owned records; upsert-only = never delete; create-only = never update or delete.

variables.name: Default target
variables.description: Fallback record value (IP or CNAME target) when a container omits the dockroute.target label. E.g. your server's LAN or WAN IP.

variables.name: Domain filter
variables.description: Optional comma-separated allowlist of DNS zones DockRoute may touch. Empty = all zones the token can see.

variables.name: Resync interval (seconds)
variables.description: Interval of the periodic full reconcile that backs up the event stream.

variables.name: Cloudflare API token
variables.description: Required when provider is cloudflare. Needs Zone > DNS > Edit (+ Account > Cloudflare Tunnel > Edit for tunnel publishing).

variables.name: Cloudflare account ID
variables.description: Only needed for Cloudflare Tunnel publishing.

variables.name: Cloudflare tunnel ID
variables.description: Only needed for Cloudflare Tunnel publishing. Uses an existing tunnel - you keep running cloudflared yourself.
